intended_purpose: Circular transit gate with energy arcs; candidate for interstellar travel infrastructure art.

rendering.pivot_status: starting value; refine against visible bounds before import

style_intent.lighting: upper-left neutral key, soft fill, thin rim

team_color.implementation_note: Generated shades and edge pixels vary; do not rely on exact RGB equality. Create and inspect a magenta livery mask before recoloring; preserve neutral hull and white-cyan emission.

scale.note: Canvas sizes and visible lengths are concept framing, not gameplay or physical scale. Normalize chosen assets at import; retain aspect ratio.

integration.alpha_blending: straight-alpha source; convert only if engine requires it
integration.icon_guidance: Fit using visible alpha bounds plus consistent padding for selection icons. Use target relative lengths separately for world-map sprites. Review thin features at final display size.
integration.mipmap_guidance: Test downsampling and transparent-edge halos against actual game backgrounds.
integration.gameplay_contract: Class and roles are intended art uses only; weapons, damage, costs, technology, and movement rules must come from game design.

remaining_checks: strict grayscale and magenta-only hull colors
